stories.title: Blueberry grower in Australia trials driverless tractors and autonomous harvesting
stories.summary: Western Berry, a blueberry grower 100 kilometres north of Perth, Australia, is trialling driverless tractors for spraying, weed control, and transport to address labor shortages. The 120-hectare operation expects to harvest just under 1,500 tons this year, with mechanical harvesting costing approximately A$0.50 per kg compared with A$6 for manual labor.

stories.title: Estonia to close border with Russia after arson attack on local drone maker
stories.summary: Estonia will close its road border crossings with Russia beginning on Dec. 1, following an attempted arson attack on drone maker Threod Systems in Viimsi. Estonian officials stated the attack was carried out at the behest of the GRU, Russia’s military intelligence service, and that closing the borders will reduce Russia’s ability to conduct hostile activities.

stories.title: Camp Lejeune Turns Military Drones Into Tools for Firefighters and First Responders
stories.summary: Camp Lejeune deployed about a dozen Skydio X2D drones to detect fires and assess hazards across its nearly 250-square-mile installation. The base plans to expand drone use to building interiors with Teledyne FLIR Black Hornet 3 units and to support water safety responses.

stories.title: MatrixSpace Portable C-UAS Detection Solutions Now Available on JIATF 401 C-UAS Marketplace
stories.summary: MatrixSpace's portable counter-UAS solutions are now available on the Department of War's Joint Interagency Task Force 401 C-UAS Marketplace. The listing enables U.S. federal procurement offices, military commands, and pre-cleared allied defense ministries to access the technology through rapid acquisition pathways.

stories.title: MicroVision Lidar Powers Commercial Driverless Trucking at Scale with Kodiak AI
stories.summary: MicroVision announced a partnership with Kodiak AI to integrate its IRIS long-range lidar into Kodiak's sixth-generation autonomous platform. Kodiak plans to launch unsupervised driverless long-haul commercial service by the end of 2026 and scale deployments throughout 2027.

stories.title: Wing Drone Nest Needs No Trustee Vote in Ohio: 'It's Coming'
stories.summary: Wing does not need a vote of Union Township’s trustees to put a drone nest at the Eastgate Walmart east of Cincinnati. The township’s recording of the board’s November 10 meeting shows chair Joe Dills asking whether the service was already legal and being told it would be permitted along with the store’s approved use.

stories.title: Royal Air Force says Protector RG1 uncrewed aircraft tracked a Russian vessel for more than 10 hours
stories.summary: A Royal Air Force Protector RG1 tracked a Russian vessel for more than 10 hours in October, gathering intelligence while working alongside the Royal Navy’s HMS Tyne. The RAF says Protector has joined its P-8A Poseidon aircraft in monitoring waters around the British Isles following its first operational mission over UK waters.

stories.title: Intelic connects Saab airborne radar into C-UAS command and control system “within minutes”
stories.summary: Intelic integrated its NEXUS command-and-control platform with Saab’s Giraffe 1X radar in 30 minutes during a field test at a military base in the Netherlands. The combined system detects aerial targets, filters out birds, and allows commanders to initiate interception responses directly through the NEXUS interface.

stories.title: Siemens Delivers Final Desiro ML Train to ÖBB
stories.summary: Siemens handed over the 294th and final Desiro ML train to ÖBB, completing a major procurement programme. All 294 trains, comprising 898 rail carriages, will operate throughout Austria in configurations ranging from 75 to 101 metres in length.

stories.title: The ticket into the game of transformation: PRASA takes rail ticketing digital
stories.summary: PRASA has invested in modernizing its ticketing systems to introduce cashless payments and digital validation cards. Train and bus commuters will be able to buy tickets through four channels: WhatsApp, the PRASA mobile app, an e-commerce platform, and handheld point of sale (POS) devices.

stories.title: Fresh GJ-11 footage gives a glimpse of weapon bay on China’s next-gen drone
stories.summary: China released new images of its GJ-11 stealth combat drone on Monday, showing its internal weapon bay and shielded jet nozzle. The footage, aired by state broadcaster CCTV, highlights the drone's ability to coordinate with manned aircraft and conduct forward reconnaissance. The GJ-11 entered operational service no later than 2025 and has been tested at a desert facility in northwestern China.

stories.title: Duke Robotics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
stories.summary: Duke Robotics reported third-quarter revenue increased 38% year-over-year and announced a strategic collaboration with CRONOS to expand its IC Drone platform into Greece. The company identified potential large-scale projects in Greece representing tens of millions of euros in aggregate project activity over several years, with cash resources expected to support operations into 2028.

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Could Match Waymo’s U.S. Miles in 2027, JPMorgan Says
stories.summary: JPMorgan said Tesla's robotaxi network could match Waymo's U.S. autonomous mileage in the second half of 2027 with an active fleet of about 18,000 vehicles, while maintaining a 'Neutral' rating and $430 price target on the stock.

stories.title: Airservices Australia launches Flight Information Management System services
stories.summary: Airservices Australia launched its Flight Information Management System (FIMS), a national platform allowing approved UTM service suppliers to deliver digital services to drone operators. The first group of approved suppliers, AvSoft, OneSky Systems, and Yarra Drones, are beginning to deliver FIMS-enabled services, with a second group expected to commence integration activities soon.

stories.title: Delivery drones are coming. For some with PTSD, that's a terrifying prospect.
stories.summary: Amazon announced plans to expand its Prime Air delivery drone program to “nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026.” The expansion suggests flying robots dropping payloads onto suburban lawns will soon be commonplace, potentially triggering anxiety for people with post-traumatic stress disorder or other anxiety-related disorders.

stories.title: SkyGrid and MIT Lincoln Laboratory Extend Low-Altitude Weather Forecasting Research
stories.summary: SkyGrid and MIT Lincoln Laboratory extended their research partnership to develop high-resolution weather forecasting systems for advanced air mobility, with the next phase running until July 2027. The collaboration aims to improve forecasts for low-altitude operations, including autonomous cargo flights and passenger-carrying electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft.

stories.title: Russia’s Barometer “develops wheeled barrier to protect airfields from drone attacks” – TASS
stories.summary: Russia’s Barometer patented a wheeled barrier designed to shield airfields from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) attacks. The utility model features a frame with protective modules containing three to four metal plates, allowing the barrier to function in two positions and connect into a continuous line of defence.

stories.title: Putin Humiliated as His Crown Jewel Is Hit Amid Record Drone Blitz
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck the $3.6 billion Kerch Bridge, closing the 12-mile crossing to traffic and delaying passenger trains. Sergei Aksyonov, the Kremlin-installed leader of Crimea, said restrictions would remain in place until at least midday while officials assess the damage.

stories.title: UK drone roll-out advances with detect-and-avoid and delivery testing
stories.summary: The UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) authorized Amazon's Prime Air to expand drone deliveries in Darlington, increasing eligible households from around 600 to roughly 8,000. This approval grants the world's first SAIL 4 operating authorisation, allowing flights over more densely populated communities.

stories.title: Russia Claims Ukraine Launched Largest Drone Assault of the War With Over 2,000 UAVs
stories.summary: Russia’s Defense Ministry claimed its air defense systems intercepted 2,049 Ukrainian drones, four Flamingo cruise missiles, and seven guided aerial bombs within 24 hours, marking what Moscow describes as the largest Ukrainian drone attack since the beginning of Russia’s full-scale invasion.

stories.title: An Eric Trump-backed military robot startup missed payroll on October 30; its CEO had borrowed $4.6 million from the company to purchase a California home
stories.summary: Foundation, a San Francisco military robot startup backed by Eric Trump, missed its October 30 payroll and has not paid some employees nearly two weeks later. The company’s CEO, Sankaet Pathak, borrowed $4.6 million from the business in 2025 to purchase a home in Sausalito, California, while Foundation seeks a new funding round at a reported $3 billion valuation.

stories.title: AI Security Technology Developed to Detect Autonomous Vehicle Hacks With 99.87% Accuracy
stories.summary: Sookmyung Women's University announced that a research team led by Professor Jung Seong-hun and undergraduate student Kim Ji-su developed an AI technology called “X-SPUR” that detects cyberattacks on in-vehicle communication networks with 99.87% accuracy. The system explains the basis for its decisions by analyzing normal communication data, and the findings were published in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics.

stories.title: Ghana, DRC, and other African countries feature in new report linking 50 African women to Russia's attack drone industry used to fight Ukraine
stories.summary: A new report links Ghana and the Democratic Republic of Congo to a deal with a Russian defense company producing attack drones. The investigation identifies roughly 50 African women working at the Alabuga Special Economic Zone, where they are drawn into the production of Geran-series attack drones used by the Russian military.

also.title: Russia’s Alabuga Factory Promises Opportunity to African Women—But the Jobs Support Shahed Drone Production

stories.title: The Role of Airborne Early Warning & Control Platforms in One-Way-Attack Drone Defense
stories.summary: Iran launched an estimated 4,400 Shahed-family one-way-attack drones against Israel and U.S. military installations between February 28th and early April, with the U.A.E. alone targeted by 2,210 drones. The conflict highlighted the critical role of airborne early warning & control platforms, such as the U.S. Navy’s E-2D Hawkeye II, in detecting low-flying drones that ground-based radars struggle to track.

stories.title: Pentagon Security Scare Exposed After French Tourist Allegedly Flies Drone Over Military Headquarters, Pete Hegseth Vows to Protect U.S. Airspace
stories.summary: A French tourist faces federal criminal allegations for allegedly flying a DJI Mini 3 drone over the Pentagon on October 29, 2026, without an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate or authorization for restricted airspace. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth vowed to protect U.S. airspace as federal agencies announced new counter-drone coordination measures on November 9.

stories.title: A $3,000 Drone Against A Million-Dollar Missile: How Modern Warfare Is Changing
stories.summary: Chief of Defence Staff General NS Raja Subramani warned at the ANI National Security Summit 3.0 in New Delhi that using a million-dollar missile to counter a $2,500 or $3,000 drone creates unsustainable economic imbalances. He identified three shifts in modern warfare: changing cost calculations, competition for AI and critical minerals, and the expansion of battlefields across entire national territories.

stories.title: Drone Federation India Proposes 22 Measures to Boost Domestic Drone Component Manufacturing, Reduce Import Dependence
stories.summary: The Drone Federation India released a whitepaper with 22 policy recommendations to strengthen domestic drone component manufacturing and reduce import dependence. The document, titled ‘Making the Swadeshi Switch’, was presented at the Bharat Drone Stack Conference 2026 in Bengaluru and includes proposals for Indian-content requirements and targeted incentives.

stories.title: Ukraine launches biggest drone attack on Russia since war began
stories.summary: Ukraine launched its biggest overnight drone attack on Russia since the full-scale war began in 2022, with Moscow saying its air defense forces brought down 1,336 Ukrainian drones across 16 regions. That surpasses a previous record of 1,254 drones registered on October 29.

stories.title: Nokia to develop ISAC technology for US military drone detection project
stories.summary: Nokia Federal Solutions won a US Department of War contract to develop integrated sensing and communications technology for the RAPID project. The system uses 5G and 6G networks to detect drone threats, partnering with Texas Tech University and DeepSig.

Estonian drone company targeted in sabotage attempt as part of ‘Russia’s hybrid war against Europe’: Prime Minister Michal
stories.summary: Estonian authorities accused Russian intelligence of orchestrating a Nov. 14 sabotage attempt targeting drone manufacturer Threod Systems, which Prime Minister Kristen Michal described as part of a broader hybrid war against Europe. The Estonian Foreign Ministry announced that all Estonian-Russian border crossing points would close as of Dec. 1, while the Kremlin stated it is verifying the allegations.

stories.title: Industry Minister inspects 5 factories specializing in industrial robotics, automation systems
stories.summary: Egypt's Industry Minister Khaled Hashem inspected five factories in the Third Settlement Industrial Zone to review production operations and expansion plans. The tour included Aria Technologies, which produces over 100 industrial robots annually with a 40% local component ratio, and Jeans Car for Industry, which operates a specialized vehicle upholstery training school.

stories.title: IRGC Navy captures US drone intact over Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolution Guards Corps Navy captured a US MQM-170 drone intact south of Qeshm Island after taking control of its flight guidance system. The drone had been operating in the area to track and identify air defence and electronic warfare systems.

stories.title: NJ Transit board authorizes $65M to improve Hudson-Bergen light rail
stories.summary: NJ Transit’s board of directors authorized $65.6 million for capital improvements on the Hudson-Bergen Light Rail system, the first allocation of a planned $250 million investment over the next five years. The funds will support elevator upgrades at the 8th Street, 9th Street and Bergenline Avenue stations, overhauls of light rail vehicles and right-of-way improvements.

More than 2,200 km of anti-drone protection has been installed along Ukraine’s frontline roads — Ministry of Defence
stories.summary: The State Special Transport Service installed anti-drone nets on more than 2,200 km of Ukraine’s frontline roads since April 2025. The Ministry of Defense stated the work is ongoing to protect vehicles from Russian drone strikes and maintain vital logistics routes.

Elite Robots Launches CE-Compliant ELITEMISSION Mobile Manipulators Globally
stories.summary: Elite Robots launched its CE-compliant ELITEMISSION mobile manipulators globally, pairing collaborative robotic arms with autonomous mobile platforms to navigate between workstations. The systems support machine loading, precision component handling, and material transfer across automotive, electronics, semiconductor, and new energy sectors.

stories.title: Taiwan’s N700ST train completes mainline test
stories.summary: Taiwan High Speed Rail found eight employees falsified track inspection records.

stories.title: Ukrainian servicemen from the special police unit Hyzhak prepare a Gara, a Ukrainian multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with AI elements, in the Donetsk region of Ukraine in May. UN diplomats will meet next week in Switzerland to discuss AI use in war.
stories.summary: The UN prepares to discuss autonomous weapons this week, as insiders say hopes of meaningful, binding regulations around AI in warfare are slim and time may be running out.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Armed Sea Drone Wins Nighttime Battle Against Russian Naval Drone, Video
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Navy reported on November 16 that a Sargan 3000 unmanned surface vessel destroyed a Russian naval drone using its automated gun turret during a nighttime engagement in difficult weather conditions. The Navy did not specify the exact location or date of the operation, noting that operators identified the target despite limited visibility.

stories.title: Delhi-Patna Bullet Train Route: Five Stations Proposed in Bihar, Including Katihar
stories.summary: A proposed 1,500-km Delhi-Guwahati high-speed rail corridor will connect Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Assam, with five stations in Bihar including Buxar, Patna, Begusarai, Khagaria, and Katihar. The Delhi-Patna journey is projected to take approximately 4 hours and 41 minutes, down from the current 11 to 14 hours, using Japanese Shinkansen technology at speeds up to 320 kmph.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor to standardize sensors across Kia, 42dot and Motional… Integrating autonomous driving data
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor will standardize the sensor systems of Hyundai Motor, Kia, 42dot and Motional into a single framework based on the NVIDIA ecosystem. The company plans to operate the Saemangeum AI Data Center, capable of accommodating more than 50,000 GPUs, starting in 2029.

stories.title: Samsung and LG to face off in humanoid robots at next year's CES… Commercialization race accelerates
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics and LG Electronics are preparing to unveil humanoid robots at CES 2027 in Las Vegas, USA, next January. LG Electronics signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Korea Robotics Industry Promotion Agency on Nov. 13 to establish safety verification systems, while Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong inspected high-difficulty motion demonstrations at the RX Business Promotion Office in Seoul.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes Russian industrial sites as Moscow downs drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone attacks killed at least one person and wounded five in Rostov Region, while damaging industrial facilities in Tatarstan and a petrochemical complex owned by Sibur. Russia’s Defense Ministry stated it intercepted 533 drones over 12 regions and Crimea, and Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin reported 191 drones intercepted near the capital.

stories.title: Galileo C1-W Robot Dog Deployed in Polish Warehouses, Setting Overseas Benchmark for Domestic Embodied Intelligence
stories.summary: Galileo Robotics launched a C1-W quadruped robot for warehouse inspection and security patrols in a Poznan, Poland logistics park. The system covers over 2,000 square meters, increasing inspection frequency to every three hours and reducing anomaly response time from hours to minutes.

stories.title: Arbitration ruling orders Ethiopia Railways to pay Turkish contractor over conflict-stalled line
stories.summary: The London Court of International Arbitration ordered Ethiopian Railways Corp to pay Turkish contractor Yapı Merkezi US$307.6m for construction works on the Awash – Kombolcha – Hara Gebeya railway, which were suspended due to the war in Tigray.

NAAMIF event highlights production plans and infrastructure priorities for commercial Advanced Air Mobility
stories.summary: Electra CEO Marc Allen outlined plans for the company’s EL9 Ultra Short production facility in Springfield, with a design-build request for proposals planned for the fourth quarter of 2026 and a targeted opening in 2029. The facility aims for an annual capacity increasing in phases to 800 aircraft.

stories.title: European aviation agency extends Saudi, Gulf, Iran airspace alerts until Jan. 31
stories.summary: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) extended airspace warnings for Saudi Arabia, Jordan, the Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman, Lebanon, Iraq, and Iran until Jan. 31, 2027, citing security risks from the conflict between the United States and Iran. The agency advised airlines to avoid designated portions of the Jeddah Flight Information Region and specific Persian Gulf waters, while allowing necessary airport arrivals and departures under appropriate risk assessments.

stories.title: Fire breaks out near two oil depots in Russia's Azov following drone attack – media
stories.summary: Rostov Region Governor Yury Slyusar confirmed fires at four industrial facilities in Azov following a drone attack, with emergency services currently working at the scene. The attack also damaged three private houses and a gas pipeline in the Millerovo district, while drones were shot down over Rostov-on-Don and Taganrog.

stories.title: Cryptographic Anchoring Catches Post Hoc Tampering in Autonomous Robot
stories.summary: Researchers Tan Gürpinar and Mehmet Akif Gulum demonstrated a lightweight cryptographic framework that achieves one hundred percent post hoc tamper detection for autonomous multi-agent robotic decision logs by anchoring compact Merkle roots to a public blockchain ledger. Published in Frontiers in Blockchain, the peer-reviewed study evaluates the architecture across twelve adversarial attack classes, with every attempted modification identified against on-chain commitments across twelve thousand experimental trials and zero false positives in one thousand honest simulation runs.

stories.title: Modi Says Almost Entire Indian Railway Network Electrified
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi claimed that almost the entire Indian railway network has now been electrified, noting that the project reached only 30 per cent completion by 2014 after about 90 years of work.

stories.title: Inside Moree’s police drone operation: what we learned
stories.summary: NSW Police Aviation Command Commander Superintendent Chris Nicholson explained that two DJI Matrice 4TD drones stationed in Moree are operated remotely by pilots at Bankstown Airport to provide situational awareness for urgent calls. Since the trial began, the drones have assisted with 14 missing-person reports, located 133 vehicles, and supported more than 200 arrests.

stories.title: Shanxi Survey Lists Six Advanced Air Mobility and Drone Entities: One Active, Two Announced, Three Unverified
stories.summary: Shanxi's provincial government signed 21 measures to speed up the low-altitude economy on May 16, 2024, setting subsidy caps of up to 30 million yuan per general airport. The measures took effect on January 1, 2024, and expire on December 31, 2026, while verified passenger-carrying operations remain thin.

stories.title: Autonomous Driving to Be Introduced for Ground Handling at Incheon Airport...Level 4 Commercialization from 2030
stories.summary: Incheon International Airport Corporation established operating standards for autonomous vehicles in the aircraft movement area, permitting Level 3 operations with a driver on board. The corporation plans to commercialize Level 4 driverless vehicles in phases starting in 2030, following test runs in low-risk zones during 2028–2029.

stories.title: Man behind the Navy’s unmanned vessel
stories.summary: The Republic of Singapore Navy began conducting operational patrols with Maritime Security Unmanned Surface Vessels in 2025 to monitor and respond to maritime threats in Singapore’s waterways.

stories.title: Robinson Helicopter Company Exhibits Broadened Portfolio of Manned and Unmanned Helicopters at European Rotors in Lyon December 1-3, 2026 - Stand #165
stories.summary: Robinson Helicopter Company will host a panel discussion on single-engine operations in European airspace on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 13:15 in Stand #165. Moderated by Joan Serra of GAMA, the session features David Smith, Benoit Gatefait, and David Pitterle discussing safety, efficiency, and regulatory considerations.

stories.title: Rail Accidents Decline, but Similar Incidents Keep Recurring... MOLIT to Prepare Comprehensive Measures This Year
stories.summary: MOLIT convened agencies and experts at the fourth Rail Safety Meeting to address recurring rail accidents, which fell from 82 in 2022 to 42 last year. The ministry plans to inspect all 1,609,000 wooden sleepers nationwide by year-end and replace about 16,000 older units, while shortening the replacement interval for KTX multiple-unit relays from 15 years to five.

stories.title: Unmanned ground vehicles to drive future of land wars
stories.summary: Ukraine planned to produce more than 15,000 Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) during 2025, compared with approximately 2,000 units produced in 2024. By early 2026, the Ukrainian Ministry of Defence reported nearly 24,500 UGV missions during the first three months of the year alone, with over 9,000 missions conducted in March.

stories.title: ‘Like one of those ski lifts’: Zoox robotaxis roll into Atlanta
stories.summary: Zoox robotaxis are carrying a limited number of riders in Atlanta after more than a year of mapping the city’s streets. The autonomous vehicles are available to Zoox employees and their friends and family in several Midtown neighborhoods, including Home Park and Atlantic Station.

stories.summary: Pony.ai and Toyota launched fully driverless commercial services with their Gen-7 bZ4X Robotaxi in Guangzhou on Nov. 16, 2026. The companies are testing the model and preparing for deployment in other major Chinese cities, progressing toward a planned deployment of around 1,000 bZ4X Robotaxis.

stories.title: UN talks face deadlock as US and Russia oppose curbs on autonomous weapons
stories.summary: The UN convened a meeting in Geneva on Monday (16 November) to discuss whether to launch negotiations on legally binding controls on autonomous weapons. The US favours non-legally binding guidelines and has proposed five years of negotiations, while the meeting’s chair has proposed two years of negotiations to draw up a legally binding protocol.

stories.title: Shenzhen Driverless Taxis: 188 km² Baidu License
stories.summary: Baidu Inc. obtained a license to provide driverless ride-hailing services under the Apollo Go brand in Shenzhen, covering 188 square kilometres. The company plans to add 200 fully driverless robotaxis during 2026, ahead of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting on November 18 and 19, 2026.

stories.title: NTT Mobility to Test Mapless Autonomous Buses on Japanese Public Roads in 2027
stories.summary: NTT Mobility announced plans to test autonomous buses on Japanese public roads in February 2027 using an AI driving system that does not require detailed digital maps. The tests will operate at Level 2 autonomy with a human driver on board, utilizing an electric bus manufactured by eVersum and technology from Imagry.

stories.title: High Speed Rail Isn't Just Fast Trains, There Are Rigidly Defined Categories
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) defines three tiers of Passenger Equipment Safety Standards, with Tier III allowing speeds up to 220 mph. However, the agency stipulates that high-speed trains can't travel faster than 160 mph on any track with at-grade crossings.

stories.title: Ivy City rally targets Waymo charging site after DC robotaxi bill stalls
stories.summary: Ivy City residents rallied Sunday against a planned Waymo charging facility near the Alexander Crummell School, three days after a D.C. Council committee declined to advance a bill authorizing driverless passenger service. Organizers cited concerns about traffic, noise, pedestrian safety, surveillance, and air pollution from round-the-clock operations.

stories.title: Echodyne Awarded $250 Million JIATF-401 Counter-UAS Contract
stories.summary: Echodyne announced an indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract with a $250 million ceiling and a 36-month ordering period to support the Joint Interagency Task Force 401’s Domestic Shield program. The agreement provides a path to acquire counter-unmanned aircraft system capabilities for force protection, base defense, and counter-drone operations in the United States and abroad.

also.title: BAE Systems Integrates Echodyne Radar into BATS Counter-UAS System

stories.title: The driverless taxis, robots and tech companies in APEC host city Shenzhen show China's ambitions
stories.summary: Shenzhen hosts the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit Wednesday and Thursday, drawing representatives from 21 members including U.S. President Donald Trump and Russia’s leader Vladimir Putin. The city, home to companies like Huawei, BYD, and Tencent, suspended drone deliveries and reduced robotaxi services ahead of the gathering.

stories.title: EHang completes Sri Lanka's first human-carrying eVTOL flights
stories.summary: EHang announced its EH216-S aircraft completed Sri Lanka's first human-carrying eVTOL flights in Colombo on November 11, marking the first such flights in South Asia. The company stated this advances its Global Fast Track Program to practical flight validation, with future work focused on regulatory reviews and commercial operations.

stories.title: LG, KIRIA sign MOU to bolster humanoid robot safety and quality
stories.summary: LG Electronics signed a memorandum of understanding with the Korea Institute For Robot Industry Advancement (KIRIA) on the 13th to jointly establish a safety and usability evaluation system for humanoid robots. The company plans to pursue a domestic pilot safety certification for its in-house robot, LG CLOiD, ahead of unveiling a bipedal robot in the first quarter of next year.

also.title: LG Electronics Partners With State Robot Agency on Humanoid Safety
LG Electronics, Korea Robot Industry Promotion Institute team up to boost humanoid robot safety
LG Electronics Partners With Korean Robotics Group to Develop Humanoid Safety Standards

stories.title: Faraday Future Founder and Global CEO YT Jia Shares Weekly Updates on Robots Delivery to Central Michigan University, Brain Blocks AI Module, and Industrial Scenario Validation
stories.summary: FFR delivered two Aegis Ultra robots to Central Michigan University, its first customer in Michigan, and released financial results showing the acquired robotics business generated approximately $2.3 million in revenue for the first nine months of the year.

also.title: Faraday Future Showcases Growth in AI Robotics, Brain Blocks and Industrial Applications

stories.title: ABB Robotics Compact Robots Reduce Cycle Times for Precision Manufacturing
stories.summary: ABB Robotics expanded its industrial robot portfolio with the IRB 1700 and IRB 1700ID, delivering up to 20% shorter cycle times and payloads from 6-12 kg. The robots feature service intervals of up to 20,000 hours between oil changes and a footprint 50% smaller than their predecessors.

stories.title: Hoban Group pilots delivery and security robots at apartments and HQ
stories.summary: Hoban Group began piloting delivery and security robots at apartment complexes and its headquarters in Seocho-gu, Seoul, to test residential and facilities management services. The company is using WATT robots for cargo delivery and Dogu Robotics for unmanned security, analyzing operating statistics and user surveys to develop future service models and robot-friendly design data.

stories.title: Palm Desert Approves Regional Public Safety Center and Puts Drone Vote on Hold
stories.summary: The Palm Desert City Council voted 4–1 on Nov. 12 to approve a $1.2 million regional public safety center, with Palm Desert, Rancho Mirage, and Indian Wells expected to share the cost. The council deferred a decision on a separate $4.5 million five-year drone contract with Axon Enterprise until January to allow more time for public outreach.

stories.title: Russian authorities report drone attack on Moscow
stories.summary: Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin reported that 15 drones were shot down at 1 a.m., adding that 82 had been downed since Sunday evening and another 17 later. Yaroslavl Governor Mikhail Yevrayev stated that traffic toward Moscow was blocked at the intersection of Moskovsky Avenue and the Southwestern Ring Road while Ministry of Defense units work to repel the attack.

stories.title: Amazon Changed Baton Rouge Drone Routes After 100 Neighbors Showed Up
stories.summary: Amazon adjusted drone flight heights and dispersed routes over Baton Rouge after about 100 residents voiced concerns at an October 1 meeting, the Wall Street Journal reported on November 15. The company stated that approximately 30 drones leave the hub hourly, though the report does not specify if the Federal Aviation Administration approved the altitude changes.

stories.title: Autonomous & Self-Driving Vehicle News: Rivian, CoreWeave, Wayve, Kakao, Nvidia, Kia, ASI, TIER IV, MAN Truck & Bus, Komatsu, May Mobility, Volkswagen, Tesla, Terawatt & Waymo
stories.summary: AutoMobility LA opens November 19, 2026, with a panel featuring National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Administrator Jonathan Morrison on federal regulatory frameworks for autonomous systems.

stories.title: DHS chief Mullin says Iran poses daily threat to Trump and his family amid drone concerns
stories.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin stated that President Donald Trump and his family are Iran's top targets, with officials receiving daily intelligence about potential drone threats. Mullin also identified countering unmanned aircraft systems as his primary issue, noting that the U.S. military detected 378 drone incursions along the southern border in the previous 30 days.

also.title: Mullin says Iran poses daily threat to Trump and family, flags explosive drone risks

stories.title: Inside the Chinese factory building humanoid robots for the world
stories.summary: Leju Robotics and Dongfang Precision Group launched a 15,000-square-meter facility in Foshan, China, in March 2026 to produce three humanoid robot models with a target of up to 10,000 units per year. The joint venture, called DF Primo, faces the engineering challenge of maintaining quality consistency across more than 1,000 components in each unit.

stories.title: Brazilian Army receives 30 quadcopters to develop a drone swarm system
stories.summary: The Military Institute of Engineering (IME) received the first batch of ten SkyDrones SD10 quadcopters, with all 30 planned units already delivered. The program aims to develop a drone swarm system where a single operator coordinates multiple aircraft using artificial intelligence and coordination algorithms developed by IME's LIARC laboratory.

stories.title: Pentagon Ignored Army’s Warnings About Iran’s Drones
stories.summary: The Pentagon ignored Army officers' warnings about deploying Ukrainian technology to counter Iranian Shahed drones before the Kuwait attack. Several officers who raised the alarm were subsequently fired or forced into early retirement.

also.title: 'Disgusting': Pentagon blasts startling report Hegseth ignored killer drone warnings
Six US soldiers died at Port Shuaiba with no counter-drone system in place, an Army whistleblower says
Army whistleblower says commanders ignored warnings before the Iranian drone attack that killed six soldiers in Kuwait
Pentagon ignored warnings before Iran drone killed 6 US service members in Kuwait, whistleblower claims
Soldier files complaint against Pentagon for deadly drone strike in Kuwait
Pentagon faces mounting pressure after whistleblower complaint over deadly Kuwait drone strike

stories.title: 5-Ton Payload, 2,600-km Range: China’s Largest Cargo Drone W5000 Makes First Flight
stories.summary: Chinese company Air White Whale conducted the first test flight of its W5000 cargo drone on November 14 at Otog Qianqi Airport in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. The aircraft, which has a maximum payload of 5 metric tons and a range of up to 2,600 kilometers, completed a 30-minute flight to assess control stability and propulsion performance. Commercial operations are scheduled to begin in late 2027 following certification.

also.title: China Flies W5000 Cargo Drone, Claiming World’s Largest Autonomous Payload

stories.title: DHL Supply Chain pilots adaptive robotics and AI orchestration in warehouse operations
stories.summary: DHL Supply Chain began introducing AI orchestration technology into operational warehouses after a successful proof of concept. The company is testing adaptive AI-powered robots that interpret changing conditions to coordinate workflows, building on a network that has already installed more than 9,000 robots and completed more than 1.5 billion robotic picks.

stories.title: US military to test autonomous medical evacuation aircraft in Morocco
Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2.5 with improved dexterity and industrial capabilities
stories.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model that achieved success rates 30 to 100 percent higher than previous versions across more than 200 tasks. The model enabled Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot to perform automotive kitting on Mercedes-Benz production lines in Kecskemét, Hungary, and Sindelfingen, Germany, with a reported 96 percent success rate.

stories.title: Bullet train project to energise from Nov 20
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited will begin energising the Surat-Bilimora section of the 508-km Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor on Nov 20. The 2 × 25,000-volt AC traction system will support train operations at speeds of up to 320 kmph.

also.title: Bullet train tracks to go live with 25,000 volts this week: Surat-Bilimora section to be energised from No
NHSRCL to energise Surat-Bilimora bullet train section with 25,000 volts from 20th November

stories.title: The Silicon Battlefield: How GPS Spoofing, Drone Microchips, and Starlink Reshape US-Iran Conflict
stories.summary: Iranian state procurement networks exploit dual-use commercial items through complex, multi-tiered front companies operating across Dubai, Hong Kong, Turkey, and Central Asia. A shell company in the United Arab Emirates orders standard industrial microcontrollers under the guise of servicing agricultural pumps or consumer appliances.

stories.title: Belagavi pushes for stop on Mumbai-Bengaluru bullet train route
ICYMI: Trump’s Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy Provides Update Across Sunday Shows on Airspace, Outlines Ongoing Investigation, & Push to Finally Finish Air Traffic Control Modernization
Zelenskyy blames SpaceX speed limits for crippling Ukraine's drone interception
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accused SpaceX of restricting Starshield satellite terminal speeds to 161 kilometres per hour, preventing interceptor drones from catching Russian Shahed drones. Zelenskyy instructed Ukraine's foreign ministry, defence ministry, and presidential office to coordinate with the US and SpaceX to lift the restrictions.

also.title: Zelenskyy says Starshield limits hamper Ukraine’s drone defence

stories.title: TechCrunch Mobility: The Nvidia backup plan for China’s self-driving industry
stories.summary: Pony.ai CFO Leo Wang said the company is using midtier compute resources and turning to domestically produced chips to address supply constraints, noting that Chinese companies have been preparing alternatives for Nvidia chips for a couple of years.

also.title: Pony.ai says Chinese self-driving companies have a Plan B for Nvidia chips
China's self-driving industry readies Plan B without Nvidia

stories.title: Eight-Shotgun Robot Turret Built to Kill Drones Up Close
stories.summary: Italy’s Beretta Defense Technologies and Dualee demonstrated the LIVET M4 turret, which mounts eight Benelli M4 shotguns, for the Danish Armed Forces this week. The system uses AI to track up to five drones autonomously, though a human gunner retains final firing authority.

stories.title: 'Fantastic female warrior' – Drone operator Rayana killed fighting Russian forces
stories.summary: The Chechen Sheikh Mansur Volunteer Battalion announced on Nov. 14 that Rayana, a female drone operator and the first woman in the unit, was killed fighting Russian forces in Ukraine. Rayana joined the army voluntarily in 2024 and her funeral will take place in Odesa.

stories.title: SANY deploys 60 autonomous electric dump trucks at a mine in Tibet — Electrek
stories.summary: SANY deployed 60 autonomous SKT105ED electric mining dump trucks at the Zhibula copper mine in Tibet, China. The vehicles carry up to 70 tonnes of cargo and operate at an altitude of about 17,700 feet.

stories.title: Greenzie says its autonomous mowers have logged more than 255,000 miles
stories.summary: Greenzie announced last week that its autonomous mowers have surpassed 255,000 cumulative miles, mowing more than 9 billion square feet for over 200 commercial customers in 45 US states. The company provides self-driving technology to partners like Mean Green Electric Mowers, whose Vanquish Autonomous model costs $60,000 and features a 22 kWh battery.

stories.title: Avride reaches one million robot deliveries as network expands across US
stories.summary: Avride completed one million autonomous deliveries across the United States, reporting 180,000 deliveries in October and a daily volume of 7,000. The company operates in more than 30 markets, including Austin, Dallas, Jersey City, Philadelphia, and Miami, integrating with Uber Eats and Grubhub.

stories.title: Wing and Walmart launch drone delivery service in Memphis
stories.summary: Wing launched drone delivery in the Memphis metropolitan area with Walmart, extending its network into Tennessee for the first time. The service covers neighborhoods near three Walmart Supercenters in Bartlett, Cordova, and West Memphis, delivering packages up to 2.75 pounds in as little as 30 minutes.

stories.title: U.S. Army Tests in South Korea AI Acoustic Sensor Network to Detect FPV Drones

also.title: US Army Tests 3D-Printed Acoustic Drone Detector in South Korea

stories.title: Serve Robotics opens autonomous delivery network to developers and businesses
stories.summary: Serve Robotics launched the AV Delivery Developer Portal, allowing independent developers, businesses, and AI assistants to programmatically summon robots from its autonomous sidewalk delivery fleet. The launch includes a public API and a sandbox environment for testing, expanding access to the fleet beyond third-party delivery partners in 20 US cities.

stories.title: UK to test US YFQ-48A Talon Blue autonomous jet from Queen Elizabeth-class aircraft carrier in 2027
stories.summary: The UK Royal Navy announced plans to launch Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48A Talon Blue autonomous jet from a Queen Elizabeth-class aircraft carrier in 2027. The trial will evaluate whether the jet can operate alongside F-35B fighters from Britain's 65,000-tonne carriers without catapults or arresting wires.

stories.title: Russia is ‘one week from crisis’ as Ukraine’s drone blitz could bring Putin’s fuel system to its knees
stories.summary: Ukraine’s drone campaign has struck all five of Russia’s largest oil refineries since late October, potentially paralysing facilities that produce around 55 per cent of the country’s petrol. Sergei Vakulenko of the Carnegie Russia Eurasia Centre warned that accumulated reserves may cover only about a week’s consumption, raising the prospect of petrol shortages and restrictions on motorists if attacks continue.

stories.title: DOT to use $7.7M in federal and state funds to improve safety at 35 railroad crossings on Hartford Line
stories.summary: The Connecticut Department of Transportation announced it received $7.7 million in federal and state funds to improve safety at 35 railroad crossings on the Hartford Line. The project includes four quadrant gate systems at 21 crossings, which are expected to reduce vehicle collisions by 95% at each location.

stories.title: Royal Navy buys Saab radars for drone-hunting boats
stories.summary: The Royal Navy took delivery of 20 K3 Scouts under Project Beehive in April, and the boats now form part of the 1st Autonomous Squadron in Portsmouth. Saab says the system will give persistent surveillance and early warning against aerial threats at sea, protecting naval assets, commercial shipping, ports and critical national infrastructure.

also.title: Saab to Equip Royal Navy Drone Boats With Sea Giraffe Radars

stories.title: Zacua Ventures raises $135 million to invest in robotics, physical AI and industrial technology
stories.summary: Venture capital firm Zacua Ventures closed its second fund at $135 million, more than doubling its original $56 million fund to expand investments in robotics, physical AI, and industrial technologies. The San Francisco-based firm reported Fund II was 35 percent oversubscribed, attracting commitments from more than 30 corporate and institutional investors across over 20 countries.

stories.title: GITEX Global to showcase latest humanoid robots and physical AI technologies in Dubai
stories.summary: GITEX Global 2026 will introduce a dedicated robotics exhibition, GITEX World RobotiX, bringing together humanoid robot manufacturers, embodied AI developers and industrial automation companies in Dubai from December 8 to 11. Taking place at the Dubai Exhibition Centre in Expo City Dubai, the event will feature demonstrations of humanoid robots, autonomous mobile systems, quadrupeds, wearable exoskeletons and robotics development technologies.

stories.title: Irish Police Buy Israeli Anti-Drone Systems Despite Government Pledge To Halt Defence Purchases
stories.summary: Ireland’s national police force purchased Israeli-made anti-drone systems from Sentrycs to protect events during the country’s EU Council presidency, despite a government pledge to halt defense purchases from Israel. The systems, installed on rooftops near secure event locations, are operated by An Garda Síochána and were acquired through a US-based supplier.

also.title: Ireland Police Buy Israeli-Made Anti-Drone Systems Despite Government Ban on Defence Purchases
Ireland uses Israeli anti-drone systems to protect EU leaders despite government boycott pledge

stories.title: Pentagon tests autonomous ground-vehicle teams in simulated combat
stories.summary: The Pentagon tested four autonomous ground vehicles at Fort Knox in mid-October, with a human operator controlling any simulated engagement. The exercise, part of DARPA’s RACER program, involved the vehicles scouting and supporting each other, with further tests scheduled for December.

also.title: Pentagon tests pack hunting with autonomous war robots — DARPA experimented with four drone ground vehicles that detected, tracked, and engaged simulated threats

stories.title: Why global investments are turning to industrial robots
stories.summary: SoftBank Group led a $500 million investment in Germany's Agile Robots in November 2026 at an $8.5 billion valuation. The International Federation of Robotics reported 5.079 million industrial robots operating worldwide in 2025, with new installations topping 600,000 units.

also.title: Agile Robots Hits $8.5bn Valuation as SoftBank and NVIDIA Back $500m Funding Round
The Chinese Entrepreneur Backed by Both SoftBank and Nvidia Is Becoming a New Force in German Robotics

stories.title: Robots instead of a research team? OpenAI is disbanding its robotics team: Why this doesn't have to be a retreat
stories.summary: OpenAI dissolved its standalone robotics team and redeployed employees to other business units, integrating robotics research into central model development under Chief Research Officer Mark Chen. The company stated this restructuring does not signify a withdrawal from robotics but aims to accelerate progress by leveraging general AI models for physical tasks.

stories.title: BYD hits 1,000 kW in charging demo as a robotic arm connects the car without the driver's help
stories.summary: BYD executive vice president Stella Li unveiled a Solar-Storage-Charging system in Abu Dhabi that reached 1,000 kilowatts during a hands-free demonstration. A robotic arm opened the charging port and plugged in the vehicle using visual recognition and force-feedback controls, while the system combined solar power generation, battery energy storage, and Flash Charging equipment.

stories.title: Making autonomous war robots has challenges self-driving cars don't
stories.summary: German defense technology company ARX Robotics makes GEREON robots, autonomous systems that have been used by Ukraine and procured by the UK. The company says its supervised autonomy allows a single soldier to task and oversee multiple systems simultaneously, delivering more mission output with fewer personnel.

stories.title: Air taxi operator to start demoing flights above LA. Will full service be ready by 2028?
stories.summary: Archer Aviation announced Monday it will begin flying its Midnight aircraft without passengers above Los Angeles in the coming weeks, anchored out of Hawthorne Airport. The company is working with the Federal Aviation Administration to determine flight conditions and plans to include non-paying passengers in 2027, aiming to be ready for the 2028 Olympics.

stories.title: Thane Civic Body Revives Plan For Development Around Bullet Train Station; 478-Hectare Area To Be Covered
stories.summary: The Thane Municipal Corporation initiated a new integrated development plan for the 478-hectare area surrounding the proposed Thane High-Speed Railway station. The plan covers parts of Mhatardi, Dativali, Betawade, and Agasan villages under Thane jurisdiction, and Ayre, Kopar, Bhopar, Nandivli, Panchanand, Katai, and Usarghar villages under Kalyan-Dombivli jurisdiction. The proposal was submitted for approval to the General Body of the Thane Municipal Corporation after a previous draft missed its six-month deadline due to incomplete transport connection planning.

stories.title: Vietnam’s first high-speed rail lines just landed a contract worth up to 1 billion euros, and Siemens says the automatic control system planned for its trains has never run on a national high-speed network
stories.summary: Siemens Mobility and VinSpeed announced a turnkey contract worth up to 1 billion euros for Vietnam’s first high-speed rail lines on September 22, 2026. The deal covers 10 Velaro Novo trains for a 121-km Hanoi to Quang Ninh line and a 54-km Ben Thanh to Can Gio line, featuring Automatic Train Operation over the European Train Control System.

stories.title: US tries to move counter-drone efforts from 'joke' to reality
stories.summary: The US military’s counter-drone defences faced setbacks during a September test in Arizona, where several systems failed to destroy targets or struggled with extreme heat and detection issues. The Pentagon plans to spend at least $7 billion on counter-drone technology but has committed only $50 million to actual purchases so far.

stories.title: Georgia rail crossing grants jump to as much as $74.2M
US Humanoid Robot Production Could Reach 300,000 to 400,000 by 2030, J.P. Morgan Predicts
Ukraine war robots starting to down drones, could alter the kill zone
stories.summary: Ukrainian military units are deploying ground robots equipped with net launchers, machine guns, and electronic warfare equipment to down Russian surveillance and strike drones. Companies like UFORCE, Rovertech, and Ratel Robotics are developing these counter-drone systems to protect troops and robots in the kill zone, though most technology remains in testing or limited use.

stories.title: DP World partners with Dubai Future Foundation to develop autonomous port logistics
stories.summary: Dubai Future Foundation announced DP World as the first strategic partner of SHIFFT, a self-driving logistics joint venture established with Oxa. The partnership will accelerate autonomous logistics solutions at Jebel Ali Port, with potential expansion across DP World's network of more than 60 ports and terminals worldwide.

stories.title: Many drone strikes on substations get through due to Starshield speed restrictions – Zelensky
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia used more than 2,300 attack drones, 1,590 guided aerial bombs and 15 missiles against Ukraine in the past week. He stated that many strikes on substations succeeded because Starshield speed restrictions prevent interceptor drones from catching up with Russian jet-powered Shaheds.

also.title: Zelensky: Russia Launched Over 2,300 Drones, 15 Missiles in Week

stories.title: Embodied AI unveils AIR humanoid robot designed to learn factory tasks on the job
stories.summary: Swiss robotics company Embodied AI unveiled AIR at Humanoid Europe 2026, a wheeled humanoid robot designed to share factory floors with humans. The company signed contracts with major OEMs and is testing AIR with global manufacturers, planning CE marking for 2027.

stories.title: Event to Explore Robotics Revolution in Welsh Manufacturing
stories.summary: Business News Wales and the High Value Manufacturing Catapult will host a roundtable in Baglan, South Wales, on Thursday 26 November to explore how robotics can improve productivity and competitiveness in Welsh manufacturing. The session will examine barriers to adoption, including upfront investment costs and workforce skills, while identifying practical priorities for accelerating technology use among small and medium-sized manufacturers.

stories.title: Historic launch sees 4 strike drones catapulted off British supercarrier
stories.summary: The Royal Navy launched four Nyan strike drones from the deck of the supercarrier HMS Queen Elizabeth during Exercise Neptune Reach B and Heavy Lift Challenge 3 in the North Atlantic. The drones, developed by BAE Systems subsidiary Callen-Lenz, were catapulted using a bespoke pneumatic system and operated alongside a TEKEVER AR5 uncrewed aerial vehicle to reach designated targets.

stories.title: Mobilicom Prepares for US Production Amid Drone Swarm Revolution
stories.summary: Mobilicom Israel CEO Udi Altshuler says the company is preparing to complete the transition of its manufacturing operations to US soil. Mobilicom is among a narrow group of four to six firms authorized to supply products to the US autonomous platforms ecosystem even when components are produced abroad, pending the completion of domestic production lines.

stories.title: Global robotics industry races to turn AI into physical machines
stories.summary: Counterpoint Research reported that more than 22,000 humanoid robots shipped globally in the first half of 2026, a 300 per cent year-on-year increase, with shipments expected to exceed 50,000 units by year-end. Dubai is advancing its Robotics and Automation Program, targeting the deployment of 200,000 robots over 10 years up to 2032, while stakeholders will showcase technological advances at GITEX World RobotiX from December 8 to 11 at the Dubai Exhibition Centre.

stories.title: Waymo Robotaxi Tries to Pass Patrol Cars
stories.summary: A driverless Waymo taxi twice attempted to pass California Highway Patrol cars during a traffic break on Interstate 280 in San Francisco on November 6. Officers steered into the vehicle's path to force it back behind the line, and the CHP has not announced whether Waymo will face citations.

also.title: Waymo Fails to Recognize Police Car... Controversies Over Repeated Unexpected Responses in San Francisco.. Waymo Robotaxi Hesitates Repeatedly Before Traffic Control

stories.title: TÜV SÜD says simulated robot safety checks could start production up to 30% sooner
stories.summary: TÜV SÜD and Accenture presented a Physical AI Safety Suite at NVIDIA GTC Berlin that uses simulation to prepare safety assessments before robots arrive, potentially bringing production online up to 30% sooner. The concept digitizes facility and equipment assessments while retaining mandatory on-site inspections, with Accenture expecting the first large-scale deployments in warehouses within 12 months.

stories.title: After Starlink disruptions, Ukraine turns to Israeli tech to keep drones flying deep inside Russia
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces are reportedly using satellite communication terminals developed by Israeli company HiSky on their long-range drones. The six-kilogram SmartLITE system, manufactured in Italy, offers an alternative connection after repeated disruptions to SpaceX's Starlink and Starshield services.

stories.title: Drones Strike Akhtubinsk Military Airfield in Russia’s Astrakhan Region
stories.summary: Long-range strike drones reportedly hit the Akhtubinsk military airfield in Russia’s Astrakhan region overnight into Sunday, Nov. 15, triggering at least 30 explosions and a blaze, according to OSINT channel Exilenova+. Astrakhan Governor Igor Babushkin claimed Russian air defense units downed 31 drones in the northern region without disclosing ground damage.

stories.title: ASELSAN’s EJDERHA Neutralises 51 Drones Launched Simultaneously Within Seconds
stories.summary: ASELSAN neutralized 51 drones simultaneously within seconds using its EJDERHA High-Power Electromagnetic counter-UAS system during its 51st anniversary demonstration. The company stated that no directed-energy system had previously defeated this many drones at once, and EJDERHA has entered serial production.

also.title: Turkey’s ASELSAN Neutralizes 51 Drones Simultaneously With EJDERHA Electromagnetic System
Aselsan says its EJDERHA counter-drone system used electromagnetic waves to neutralise a swarm of 51 drones
Turkey successfully tests EJDERHA counter-drone system
Türkiye’s ASELSAN EJDERHA Electromagnetic Weapon Marks New Era After Disabling 51 Drones in Seconds
Turkish “dragon” electromagnetic weapon fries 51 drones in seconds

stories.title: Bahrain intercepts Iranian aerial attacks as Tehran says it attacked US base
stories.summary: Bahrain intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on Sunday, marking the first such interceptions by Bahraini air defenses since September. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it launched six drones targeting U.S. air defense radar at the Al-Rifaa helicopter base in retaliation for hostile U.S. actions.

also.title: Iran claims six-drone attack on US air defense radar in Bahrain
Bahrain intercepts Iranian drone attacks on US military base
Iran claims drone attack on US military base in Bahrain
Drone attacks on Bahrain heighten Gulf fears as Trump signals patience
IRGC Launches Six Drones at U.S. Radar at Bahrain’s Riffa Air Base, Bahrain Says It Intercepted
Bahrain sounds sirens as Iran claims drone attack on US radar system

stories.title: Autonomous ride-hailing Zoox adds downtown Las Vegas and Arts District rides, extends daily hours
stories.summary: Zoox expanded its Las Vegas service to include the Arts District and downtown, extending daily operating hours to 6 a.m. to 3 a.m. The company stated it will continue adding destinations and introduced an updated robotaxi featuring a lighter interior and greater rider comfort.

stories.title: IRGC Spokesperson: Shahed 136 Drone Costs No More Than $20,000 to Manufacture
stories.summary: The spokesperson for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) stated that the maximum cost of manufacturing a Shahed 136 drone is $20,000. The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) estimates the manufacturing cost of each Shahed 136 at between $20,000 and $50,000.

stories.title: China's railway network handles record 4.13 billion passenger trips in first 10 months of 2026
stories.summary: China State Railway Group Co., Ltd. said its network handled 4.13 billion passenger trips in the first 10 months of the year, up 4.7 percent year on year and the highest for the period on record. The operator ran an average of 11,670 passenger trains per day during the January-October period.

stories.title: UForce reaches £4.5bn after £500m raise, England Drone deal
stories.summary: UForce reached a £4.5bn valuation after raising more than £500m from investors including the UK government, with Britain’s national wealth fund contributing £113m. The Ministry of Defence said more than 70% of the content of each UK-built boat would come from British suppliers, while Oleg Rogynskyy stated the money would let UForce scale up production for Ukraine and its allies.

stories.title: A Robot Just Built a Structure in Space All on Its Own – For The First Time Ever
stories.summary: Caltech researchers, funded by DARPA, used the ASTRA robot to independently assemble a 1.4-meter reflector antenna bay in space. This first autonomous construction effort demonstrates a new method for building large structures beyond Earth, with another NOM4D project launching before the end of the year.

stories.title: Bukele Shares Footage of Rifle-Equipped Robotic Dogs in Haiti Stadium Operation
stories.summary: El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele released video showing rifle-equipped robotic dogs participating in an operation to retake Sylvio Cator Stadium in Port-au-Prince from gang control. Bukele stated the operation was conducted under a bilateral agreement between Haiti and El Salvador, involved the Haitian National Police, the Haitian Armed Forces, a task force, and Salvadoran special forces, and resulted in the stadium being secured.

stories.title: Learning from US Drone-Launching SSN(X), Why India Should Fast-track Integrated Unmanned Naval Fleet Led by SAVIOR, Matangi, and CASCADE-ASW
stories.summary: Rear Admiral Andrew Miller stated that the upcoming SSN(X) class vessels will be faster, require less maintenance, and serve as motherships for underwater drones. The US strategy envisions these submarines launching unmanned systems from torpedo tubes to extend operational reach.

stories.title: Nidus Raises $30 Million for Defense Robotics AI
stories.summary: Nidus raised $30 million to train robotics AI for defense industrial customers, starting with wire harnesses. The company has reached more than $1 million in bookings in four months and plans to hire at its New York headquarters.

stories.title: Hands-on with the Tesla Cybercab in Melbourne, a preview of the future with no steering wheel, pedals, or mirrors
stories.summary: Tesla’s Cybercab, described as the first dedicated robotaxi, visited the Sunshine store in Melbourne as part of an ANZ tour that included Sydney, Brisbane, and Canberra. The vehicle features a symmetrical interior with no steering wheel, and the article notes that while the car is capable of driving itself, regulation is not ready to enable it in late 2026.

Beijing enforces citywide drone ownership ban over security concerns
stories.summary: Beijing's ban on owning and storing drones took effect Sunday, prohibiting residents from possessing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) across China's capital. The restrictions cover both urban and rural areas of the municipality, spanning approximately 16,400 square kilometers (6,300 square miles).

stories.title: Kongsberg Unveils Arctic Hunter Drone Ship to Track Russian Submarines
stories.summary: Kongsberg Maritime unveiled the Arctic Hunter USV, a fully unmanned vessel based on a 184-foot fishing trawler, to meet the Royal Navy's Type 92 requirement for persistent antisubmarine warfare. The design, announced November 9, integrates Thales Underwater Systems' Sonar 2087 towed array and is engineered to operate in Arctic conditions for up to 60 days without human intervention.

stories.title: U.S. and China Step Up Robotaxi Push ... ‘Team Korea’ Fights Back
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor signed a memorandum of understanding with SOCAR on the 13th to supply autonomous-vehicle platforms and collect driving data, while Kia has collaborated with Kakao Mobility Corp. since July to develop purpose-built vehicles equipped with in-house autonomous-driving software.

stories.title: Epson introduces new, collaborative robot for safer, more accessible automation in cleanroom settings
stories.summary: Epson launched its AX6 Collaborative Robot in Southeast Asia, a 17 kg device designed for cleanroom environments in pharmaceutical, logistics, automotive, and electronic manufacturing. The robot features an ISO Class 5 cleanroom classification, IP54 dust and splash protection, and hand-guided teaching functionality to simplify automation deployment.

stories.title: Iran SHOOTS DOWN Another U.S. MQ-1 Drone, Irgc Shows Footage Of Missile Interception Over Qeshm
stories.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claims it shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz on November 14, 2026. The group released footage purportedly showing air defense systems intercepting the reconnaissance drone.

stories.title: Archer Midnight Air Taxi Joins Formula 1 With Plans to Carry Fans Past Race Traffic
stories.summary: Archer Aviation and Formula 1 announced a multi-year partnership on November 12 to display the Midnight electric air taxi at selected races. The aircraft, which carries a pilot and four passengers, will appear at the Las Vegas and Abu Dhabi Grand Prix events. Partners are considering dedicated landing areas and short flights for fans, with commercial service targeted for 2027 in markets like Miami and Texas.

stories.title: Westwell and RAKTA partner on autonomous transport in Ras Al Khaimah
stories.summary: Westwell signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with the Ras Al Khaimah Transport Authority (RAKTA) to advance autonomous industrial transport solutions in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The agreement makes Westwell the first partner for autonomous terminal trucks in the RAKTA Autonomous Vehicle Sandbox, a testing zone launched under the emirate’s new Autonomous Mobility Framework.

stories.title: Pakistan’s Arrow-1 Surfaces in Factory Footage as India Weighs Drone Threat
stories.summary: Pakistan’s National Aerospace Science and Technology Park moved the Arrow-1 drone from display models to apparent factory assembly, a reported production milestone that puts the Pakistan Air Force’s ground-launched jet drone programme in focus for Indian air defence planners.

stories.title: EU's U-Space Framework Sets Digital Rules for Drone Traffic Management Under Regulation (EU) 2021/664
stories.summary: The European Union's U-space framework, governed by Regulation (EU) 2021/664, replaces voice-based radio communication with machine-to-machine protocols and automated flight authorisations. It requires four core services: network identification, geo-awareness, UAS flight authorisation and traffic information.

stories.title: Financing: the Luxembourg Rail Protocol can underwrite a rail resurgence
stories.summary: The Luxembourg Rail Protocol offers strong protections for private investors in rolling stock, leading to lower financing costs and other benefits, as Howard Rosen, Chairman of the Rail Working Group, explains.

stories.title: Entering the U.S. Market: How New Tariffs Are Reshaping the Drone Industry
stories.summary: The White House issued a proclamation on August 13, 2026, imposing additional tariffs on specified UAS and components under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act. Effective September 3, certain UAS categories became subject to 100% duties, while others face 25% duties, with a further 25% duty on certain components scheduled for February 9, 2027.

stories.title: Russia's RD-93MS Takes an Unexpected Role in Future Supersonic Aviation
stories.summary: Russia is adapting the RD-93MS engine for the Strizh supersonic civil aircraft demonstrator, taking a fighter-engine design into an entirely new aviation programme. Ground tests have confirmed the required thrust characteristics, while specially developed flat nozzles and noise suppression technology address the challenges of civilian supersonic flight.

stories.title: GXO and Apptronik target deployment of up to 1,000 humanoid robots
stories.summary: GXO Logistics signed a letter of intent with Apptronik to explore a global deployment of up to 1,000 Apollo humanoid robots over the next four years. Operational trials begin in 2027, with a potential first commercial deployment in North America in late 2027, contingent on meeting agreed performance and safety targets.

stories.title: Fire reported at industrial facility in Russia's Tatarstan amid drone attack
stories.summary: A large fire was reported in Nizhnekamsk, Tatarstan, overnight on Nov. 15 amid reports of a drone attack targeting the city's industrial zone, according to local residents and Ukrainian monitoring channels.

stories.title: In the ‘kill zone’, Ukraine bets on flying evacuation drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian manufacturer Skyfall developed the Stargate evacuation drone to rescue wounded soldiers from the front line's "kill zone," where ground drones struggle to operate. The 400kg carbon-fibre craft travels at 105kmh, carries up to 150kg, and costs about US$50,000, with Skyfall aiming to produce a thousand per month by the end of 2026.

stories.title: Not Just Building Ships... HD Hyundai Bets on Unmanned Vessel Design and Technology
stories.summary: HD Hyundai launched the medium-sized unmanned surface vessel Alpha on the 12th, a project completed in seven months with US defense company Anduril Industries. The company plans to export its VAone autonomous-navigation technology and expand its design business to other ship types and overseas shipyards.

stories.title: Poland wants to obtain Ukrainian drone detection technologies in exchange for MiG-29 fighter jets
stories.summary: Poland is negotiating the transfer of two MiG-29s to Ukraine in exchange for drone detection technologies. Polish Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk said the parties are coordinating final details, with Ukrainian acoustic systems already being tested in Poland.

stories.title: Italy has begun installing anti-drone protection on the tanks it transferred to the Armed Forces of Ukraine, following Ukraine’s example — what has changed
stories.summary: The Italian military began installing anti-drone structures on B1 Centauro wheeled tanks, following adaptations made by Ukrainian troops. These metal protective structures, known as “grills,” cover the turret from above and on the sides to defend against drone attacks.

stories.title: Ukraine Says Starshield Restrictions Persist, Hampering Drone Defenses
stories.summary: Ukrainian diplomat Denys Sienik said on November 14 that widespread restrictions on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite communications persist, preventing forces from intercepting Russian jet-powered drones near the front line. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that terminals in temporarily occupied territories faced speed limits of approximately 161 kilometers per hour for five days, while SpaceX told Ukrainian officials it was not imposing any restrictions.

stories.title: Standardized Frequency Filter Optimization Reduces Motion Sickness in Autonomous Vehicle Simulations
stories.summary: Researchers Ishu Jaiswal, Somnath Buriuly, and Arpita Sinha demonstrated that embedding standardized frequency-shaping filters into a vehicle’s spatial path planner substantially reduces simulated passenger motion sickness. The study, published in Discover Vehicles, showed that trajectory planners driven by standardized frequency-weighted costs achieve lower motion sickness dose values than raw energy-minimizing formulations.

stories.title: The Vietnamese robotics market is growing rapidly due to the wave of factory relocation from China.
Sheridan Manufacturers Are Adding Robots And Hiring Workers At The Same Time
stories.summary: EMIT Technologies in Sheridan is installing four robotic arms by mid-November to handle repetitive welding, freeing an estimated 22 welders for more complex tasks. CEO Casey Osborn stated the company needs 70 welders but cannot hire them fast enough, so the robots allow the firm to produce more and create demand for additional workers.

stories.title: MetaX and UBTech's robot chip venture Xilect raises 500 million yuan
stories.summary: Xilect, a joint venture between MetaX and UBTech Robotics, completed a 500 million yuan angel round led by GGV Capital and Matrix Partners China to build a domestic computing platform for embodied AI. The company plans to tape out its chip in the second half of 2027 and begin mass production in 2028.

stories.title: Largest Air Force in the World Unveils Force Design 2026, Prioritizes AI, Autonomous Aircraft and Advanced Sensors
stories.summary: The US Air Force introduced Force Design 2026 on November 10, 2026, replacing the 2024 One Force Design framework. The new strategy prioritizes advanced sensors, artificial intelligence, and autonomous systems over individual aircraft, aiming to build an integrated network of military capabilities for contested environments.

stories.title: DJI Air 3S Firmware v01.00.1900 Lands With Six Others and No Details
stories.summary: DJI released firmware v01.00.1900 for the DJI Air 3S on November 13, 2026, alongside updates for six other drones. The release notes state only that the updates fixed known issues, with no specific details provided.

stories.title: In Romanian waters, a drone struck a ship that was heading to Ukraine
stories.summary: A drone struck the Palau-flagged cargo ship Larissa 1 in Romanian territorial waters near Sfântu Gheorghe, damaging only the cargo crane. Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed the incident and stated that the investigation is ongoing.

Chief Executive Elon Musk stated the program would eventually be available nationwide, subject to regulatory approval.

stories.summary: Attalon and ACS announced a partnership on Nov. 12, 2026, to integrate Attalon’s Valaris high-energy laser subsystems with ACS’s Bullfrog autonomous weapon station. The companies stated the pairing aims to counter low-cost weaponized drones for U.S. and allied governments.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercabs Filmed by the Dozen in Dallas Before Planned Launch
stories.summary: Dozens of Tesla Cybercabs were filmed parked in Dallas on Saturday, more than three weeks after Vice President of AI Software Ashok Elluswamy said the robotaxi would launch in the city in November. The vehicles arrived on trucks, and Tesla has not announced Cybercab rides in Dallas, where its Robotaxi service currently uses Model Ys.

stories.title: eVTOL Aircraft Cost $300,000 to $4 Million; Air Taxi Fares Seen Falling From $3-$8 to $1-$2 Per Mile
stories.summary: eVTOL aircraft purchase prices range from $300,000 to $4 million, with the EHang EH216-S listed at about $410,000. Air taxi fares are expected to start at $3 to $8 per mile in 2026-2027 and fall to $1 to $2 per mile by 2030.

stories.title: Elon Musk Says Cybercab’s $299 Monthly ‘Autonomy Fee’ is Too High
stories.summary: Elon Musk stated that the US$299 monthly autonomy fee for Tesla’s Cybercab is too high and should match the approximately US$115 monthly cost of FSD and connectivity on other models. He also noted that the vehicle will be available nationwide as regulatory approval is received, though he did not announce a price reduction.

stories.title: Ukraine’s Naval Drones Are Now Threatening Russian Targets on Land
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Main Intelligence Directorate adapted Magura naval drones to carry aerial drones for land-based strikes, destroying a Russian Pantsir-S1 air-defense system and two S-400 launchers in August. UFORCE founder Oleg Rogynskyy said the company raised $700 million in a Series A funding round, bringing its valuation to $6 billion to support expanded manufacturing.

stories.title: US Army Fires 18-Drone Swarm From Container-Launched UGV
stories.summary: The US Army demonstrated an unmanned ground vehicle that launched 18 first-person-view drones from a shipping container at Grafenwoehr Training Area in Bavaria, Germany, on November 12, 2026. The exercise, staged under the Remote Rapid Response Autonomous Contingency Team effort, involved soldiers from the 173rd Airborne Brigade operating the drones, with no procurement decision or fielding timeline announced.

stories.title: Eric Trump’s Robotics Firm in Controversial Negotiations to Sell Combat Robots to Israel
stories.summary: Eric Trump's Future Industries Foundation is negotiating a $150 million deal to sell 1,000 autonomous combat robots to Israel for use in Gaza tunnels. The company, which received over $70 million in Pentagon contracts, faces human rights concerns over its Phantom robots.

stories.title: Tesla Optimus Aims for 1M Robots a Year at $20K Each
stories.summary: Tesla started early production of its Optimus humanoid robot at its Fremont, California facility, with a planned line capacity of roughly 1 million robots per year. Elon Musk said reaching that rate could take a year or longer and that deliveries to outside companies are expected around the end of 2027.

stories.title: RAF Lakenheath Drone Incident: US Air Force Responds as Personnel Shelter in Place
stories.summary: USAF Security Forces responded to suspected unauthorized drone activity over RAF Lakenheath on the evening of 13 November 2026, directing personnel to shelter in place. The UK Ministry of Defence confirmed the situation is now resolved, while a US Air Force spokesperson stated no personnel, aircraft or infrastructure were affected.
